name: kinesisanalyticsv2
description: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink was previously known as Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics for Apache Flink.

subcommands.name: add-application-cloud-watch-logging-option
subcommands.description: Adds an Amazon CloudWatch log stream to monitor application configuration errors.

subcommands.name: add-application-input
subcommands.description: Adds a streaming source to your SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application.

subcommands.name: add-application-input-processing-configuration
subcommands.description: Adds an InputProcessingConfiguration to a SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application.

subcommands.name: add-application-output
subcommands.description: Adds an external destination to your SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application.

subcommands.name: add-application-reference-data-source
subcommands.description: Adds a reference data source to an existing SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application.

subcommands.name: add-application-vpc-configuration
subcommands.description: Adds a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) configuration to the application.

subcommands.name: create-application
subcommands.description: Creates a Managed Service for Apache Flink application.

subcommands.name: create-application-presigned-url
subcommands.description: Creates and returns a URL that you can use to connect to an application's extension.

subcommands.name: create-application-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a snapshot of the application's state data.

subcommands.name: delete-application
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified application.

subcommands.name: delete-application-cloud-watch-logging-option
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon CloudWatch log stream from an SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application.

subcommands.name: delete-application-input-processing-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes an InputProcessingConfiguration from an input.

subcommands.name: delete-application-output
subcommands.description: Deletes the output destination configuration from your SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application's configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-application-reference-data-source
subcommands.description: Deletes a reference data source configuration from the specified SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application's configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-application-snapshot
subcommands.description: Deletes a snapshot of application state.

subcommands.name: delete-application-vpc-configuration
subcommands.description: Removes a VPC configuration from a Managed Service for Apache Flink application.

subcommands.name: describe-application
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific Managed Service for Apache Flink application.

subcommands.name: describe-application-operation
subcommands.description: Provides a detailed description of a specified application operation.

subcommands.name: describe-application-snapshot
subcommands.description: Returns information about a snapshot of application state data.

subcommands.name: describe-application-version
subcommands.description: Provides a detailed description of a specified version of the application.

subcommands.name: discover-input-schema
subcommands.description: Infers a schema for a SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application by evaluating sample records on the specified streaming source (Kinesis data stream or Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream) or Amazon S3 object.

subcommands.name: list-application-operations
subcommands.description: Lists all the operations performed for the specified application such as UpdateApplication, StartApplication etc.

subcommands.name: list-application-snapshots
subcommands.description: Lists information about the current application snapshots.

subcommands.name: list-application-versions
subcommands.description: Lists all the versions for the specified application, including versions that were rolled back.

subcommands.name: list-applications
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Managed Service for Apache Flink applications in your account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves the list of key-value tags assigned to the application.

subcommands.name: rollback-application
subcommands.description: Reverts the application to the previous running version.

subcommands.name: start-application
subcommands.description: Starts the specified Managed Service for Apache Flink application.

subcommands.name: stop-application
subcommands.description: Stops the application from processing data.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more key-value tags to a Managed Service for Apache Flink application.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a Managed Service for Apache Flink application.

subcommands.name: update-application
subcommands.description: Updates an existing Managed Service for Apache Flink application.

subcommands.name: update-application-maintenance-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates the maintenance configuration of the Managed Service for Apache Flink application.
